name: Unidentified Legion Praetorian
desc:
A Legion Praetorian is said to have used the Imperial Staff while in service to [The Hundred Legions](faction:the_hundred_legions). The Praetorian is believed to have used it to destroy entire towns during the Legions' expansion.

The Praetorian and his weapon have since attained a legendary reputation, though the truth regarding their feats are a matter of some debate.
